༄༅/ /rgyud sde lnga'i gtso 'dus kyi mngon rtogs zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/dkyil 'khor ma lus kun 'dus pa/ /ye shes rnam lnga'i ngo bo nyid

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyud sde lnga'i gtso 'dus kyi mngon rtogs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dkyil 'khor ma lus kun 'dus pa/ /ye shes rnam lnga'i ngo bo nyid/ /de la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de 'i sgrub thabs mdo tsam bshad/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ ye shes mkha' 'gro nai gu mas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi man ngag rnams ni gzhi lus bde mchog lhan skyes dang dgyes mdzad lhan skyes la sbyar ba ci rigs pa yod cing bla ma rnams kyi phyag len la yang ci rigs su mdzad pa gnyis ka ltar yang rung zhing yid ches can yin no/ /de yanga'adir bde mchog lhan skyes brten nas bshad par bya ste/ de la yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su nang mchod mchod gtor yo byad rnams sna tshogs par byas nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par bya/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin rlabs la/ oṃ shū n+ya ta sogs/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ sngon po ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud ma lus pa slar 'dus te 'od du zhu ba thig ler gyur de las rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur gyur pa'i thugs kar hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las raṃ 'og phyogs su chad nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ hūṃ spros pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyis sa gzhi dang de las 'phros pa'i rwa gur du gyur cing*/ hūṃ las hūṃ dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'phros/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa nas dgu pa'i bar du gyur pas bar mtshams med par gtams nyi ma las 'bar ba'i mes rab tu zhu ste ra gur gyi phyi rol dum bu gcig tu 'dres shing phyi nang kun tu me lces gang bar gyur/ snying kha'i hūṃ gis 'od zer gyis bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ

ar+ghaṃ nas shab+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs lan gsum bya/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag dag ste me long dang gzugs brnyan ltar rang dang tshogs zhing dbyer med du gyur/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid do/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ 'dzin pa yang rang bzhin mi dmigs te chos thams cad stong pa nyid do/ / zhes mnyam par bzhag stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi gdan de'i steng du rang sems hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa rnams mnyes par byas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te he ru ka yab yum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ de rnams he ru ka yab yum kyi rnam par spyan drangs te/ hūṃ yig rdo rje dang bcas pa la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing kha in+d+ra nī la ltar rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phros pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo ba khro zhing bgegs la chags pa'i nyams can mche ba myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa zhal shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor rus pa'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i nor bu dang ral pa'i ngos la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa mi rus kyi rna cha dang mgul rgyan dang gdu bu'i tshogs dang*/ ska rags dang mchod phyir thogs kyis brgyan pa thal ba chen pos nye bar byugs shing mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan/

dpa' bo dar dpyangs dang bcas pa mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs bkrol ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud la zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po dang*/ g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar po mnan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /de la 'khyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo bskal ba'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs thams cad gnon cing g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang bas yab la 'khyud pa gcer bu skra 'khrol zhing phyag rgya lnga'i brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu brgyan dang*/ do shal can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs bas yab la 'khyud cing yab yum gnyis ka'ang lang tsho gsar du bdo ba me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yab kyi sku la rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga dang bcas pa skad cig gis grub pa'i sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i lte bar/ rdo rje gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i yon tan gyi ngo bo rang dang mtshungs pas bde mchog yab yum/ bde chen 'khor lo sku gsang ba 'dus pa sku mdog sngon po yud tsam khro ba rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang mtshungs kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis pad nyi la bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /longs spyod 'khor lo gsung mahā ma ya mthing ga phyag gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pas yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dmar mo rang mtshungs la 'khyud pa skra ser brdzes pa g.yas brkyang gis pad nyi la mi ro mnan pa'o/ /chos kyi 'khor lor thugs dgyes mdzad rdo rje mthing kha phyag gnyis ky-is rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum bdag med ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa skra ser gyen du brdzes pa g.yas brkyang gis pad nyi la tshangs pa dang drag po mnan pa'o/

/bde skyong 'khor lo 'phrin las rdo rje 'jigs byed mthing nag ma he'i zhal can/ phyag gnyis kyi gri gug dang*/ thod khrag 'dzin pas yum phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs pa g.yon brkyang gis pad nyi la ma he mnan pa'o/ /yang na thams cad hūṃ las bskyed kyang rung bar bshad do/ /rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po yang rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po rnams btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa du maṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas yum lnga bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa spros/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bor nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+ta 'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis nang mchod 'bul/ gsang mchod dang de kho na yid kyis mchod pa nyid la dran pa tsam bya'o/ /de nyid pas bstod pa ni/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thabs kyis khro bo'i skur bstan gdug pa 'dul/ /che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*/ /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan 'phrin las rab rdzogs pa/ /dkyil 'khor lnga po thams cad la/ /kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod do/

/ oṃ hrī ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ṇi ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa nyid gtso bor bzla zhing*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+rika hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ nye snying*/ rnam snang*/ dpal rdo rje khrag 'thung mkha' 'gro ma dra ba sdom pa bzhi tshul/ rdo rje snang mdzad ma sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje'i rigs/ oṃ dhe wa pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ hūṃ hrīḥṣ+tīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams kyang ci rigs par zla'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha rnams thig ler zhu ba bkra shis lha 'jam po rdo rje legs bcas dang de'i 'od zer gyis drag po mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa'i mdog can/ lus gang ba sogs spros bsdu la sems 'dzin par bshad cing*/ chos drug nyid bsgoms pa yin no/ mthar/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od gsal ngang du thim par gyur/ ces brjod cing cung zad mi rtog pa'i ngang nas mnyam par bzhag /slar yang rang nyid he ru ka yab brkyang gi nga rgyal la gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas thun mtshams la 'jug go /gtor ma/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i steng du ā las kā pa la sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba hūṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ rnams kyis mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas pa zhu sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi spyan drangs te thim pas ye shes kyi sgron gsal las/ don mtshon pa ni sa bon nam zhes gsungs/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhriḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs la/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ gong du bshad pa'i snying po rnams kyis mthar/ oṃ ā ka ro/ btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul lo/ /gong bzhin mchod bstod dang*/

mchod sbyin gtor ma nas/ kun grub shog gi bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgyas bzod gsol gshegs gsol smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /gal te dgyes mdzad lhan skyes la brten nas bsgom par 'dod na gzhi lus dgyes mdzad lhan skyes nyid du byed pa dang sku gsung thugs byin rlabs kyi rdzas skye mched drug byin rlabs kyang bya'o/ /bzlas pa dang*/ de wa pu tsu badz+ra gtso bor byed pa rnams khyad par ro/ /phyi dkyil lha lnga'i tshul du bsgom par spros na pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i shar du gsang 'dus/ lho ru dgyes mdzad/ nub tu mahā ma ya/ byang du 'jigs byed/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams la bum thod bzhi gsal 'debs/ phyi dkyil du bsgom pa'i yig rnying phal cher na gtso bo gsang ba 'dus pa la byas pa nyid mang bar 'dod pa yod na'ang*/ rang gang la mos pa nyid gtso bor byas pas chog go /de bzhin du yig rnying 'ga' na phyi dkyil 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga la brten nas yang yod do/ /shin tu zab pa'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /khyung po rnal 'byor la sogs pa'i/ /de nyid mkhyen pa'i lung gi don/ /ngag 'don tsam du bsgrigs pa yin/ /zhes pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //dge legs 'phel/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ rgyud sde lnga'i gtso 'dus kyi mngon rtogs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ PAGE 242 -- PAGE 243 - - PAGE 238 -
